notes.title: DEMO UPDATE #1 – Thank You & Fixes!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to everyone who played our demo.



We’ve fixed some bugs and made a few improvements.

Patch Notes - Update #1:

Fixed an issue where blink events wouldn't trigger when eyes were nearly closed.

Fixed a bug causing the screen to stay black after the intro cutscene if the game lost focus.

The drawer open sound effect is now properly audible.

Balanced the doctor's voice volume during the tutorial.



Thanks again for all the support and feedback!

If you have any thoughts or run into issues, feel free to join our Discord and let us know.
